name: LIFETIME
doc: Particle lifetime.

name: DELTA
doc: Delta process time.

name: NUMBER
doc: Unique number since emission start.

name: INDEX
doc: Particle index (from total particles).

name: EMISSION_TRANSFORM
doc: Emitter transform (used for non-local systems).

name: RANDOM_SEED
doc: Random seed used as base for random.

name: ACTIVE
doc: true when the particle is active, can be set false.

name: COLOR
doc: Particle color, can be written to and accessed in mesh's vertex function.

name: VELOCITY
doc: Particle velocity, can be modified.

name: TRANSFORM
doc: Particle transform.

name: CUSTOM
doc: Custom particle data. Accessible from shader of mesh as INSTANCE_CUSTOM.

name: MASS
doc: Particle mass, intended to be used with attractors. Equals 1.0 by default.

name: USERDATA1
doc: Vector that enables the integration of supplementary user-defined data into the particle process shader.

name: USERDATA2
doc: Vector that enables the integration of supplementary user-defined data into the particle process shader.

name: USERDATA3
doc: Vector that enables the integration of supplementary user-defined data into the particle process shader.

name: USERDATA4
doc: Vector that enables the integration of supplementary user-defined data into the particle process shader.

name: USERDATA5
doc: Vector that enables the integration of supplementary user-defined data into the particle process shader.

name: USERDATA6
doc: Vector that enables the integration of supplementary user-defined data into the particle process shader.

name: FLAG_EMIT_POSITION
doc: A flag for using on the last argument of emit_subparticle() function to assign a position to a new particle's transform.

name: FLAG_EMIT_ROT_SCALE
doc: A flag for using on the last argument of emit_subparticle() function to assign the rotation and scale to a new particle's transform.

name: FLAG_EMIT_VELOCITY
doc: A flag for using on the last argument of emit_subparticle() function to assign a velocity to a new particle.

name: FLAG_EMIT_COLOR
doc: A flag for using on the last argument of emit_subparticle() function to assign a color to a new particle.

name: FLAG_EMIT_CUSTOM
doc: A flag for using on the last argument of emit_subparticle() function to assign a custom data vector to a new particle.

name: EMITTER_VELOCITY
doc: Velocity of the Particles2D (3D) node.

name: INTERPOLATE_TO_END
doc: Value of interp_to_end (3D) property of Particles node.

name: AMOUNT_RATIO
doc: Value of amount_ratio (3D) property of Particles node.

name: RESTART
doc: true if the current process frame is first for the particle.

name: COLLIDED
doc: true when the particle has collided with a particle collider.

name: COLLISION_NORMAL
doc: A normal of the last collision. If there is no collision detected it is equal to (0.0, 0.0, 0.0).

name: COLLISION_DEPTH
doc: A length of normal of the last collision. If there is no collision detected it is equal to 0.0.

name: ATTRACTOR_FORCE
doc: A combined force of the attractors at the moment on that particle.
